paragraphs.text: Back to the workshop. No pot without a potter — how else could there be one? Clay-lump nature watches the potter, looking his way. Helpers crawling inside the material cannot arrange anything, capable though they be. Wisdom linked to the worlds traffic is required, and it is never found missing. No will to make means no wonders made — just grossness, never anything world-good. Test sufficiency: would mere potter-helping, all by itself, bear a pot? Rule-wondrous making says what it says.

Then the array and the fences. Never bodies from long clay-lumps or otherwise — hence arrangement excels, led by ends. Lord and un-Lord both fenced off at atomic scale: neither taken as the atom-marked. And primal stuff gets no desire-arising of its own — yet person-aim-ness stands.
